paragraphs.text: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that fetches a public web page and returns its title and plain-text summar
ess plugin that fetches a public web page and returns its title and plain-text summary to the agent.
A DeepSeek Harness Host tool plugin that fetches a public web page over HTTPS and returns its `<titl
e>` and a plain-text summary of the visible content to the agent.

- Registers one model-callable tool: `fetch_page_summary`
- Accepts an `https://` URL and an optiona

l `maxChars` cap (default 4000)
- Returns `{ url, title, summary, truncated }`; scripts, styles, and

markup are stripped
- Plain ESM JavaScript — no build step, works from both Git and npm installs
Restart the profile afterwards. The tool then appears as `fetch_page_summary` for the agent.
Ask the agent: *"Summarize https://example.com"*. The agent will call `fetch_page_summary` and recei
ve the title plus up to `maxChars` characters of visible text.
